lede: What Korean and global players run in Guild Conquest (길드 토벌전), from DCInside, the official Naver cafe and crumb.gg. Every claim links its post.
caveat: Season 7, same Piñata. Chardonnay deck best with a lineup: 4T 300G at 4.29G. Season 7 top-10 teams unpublished; live #1 at 10T 266G.
footer: Built from the research record's evidence captures.

you.summary: Swap Macaron for Chardonnay and Cherry for Melon Soda. At the Chardonnay deck's 640–1000×, 2.2G makes about 1.4–2.2T.
changes: Chardonnay in Macaron's slot, max level, all skill-amp runes; aim for 9–10★.
Melon Soda Lv.1 in Cherry's slot, no move speed; or Strawberry Crepe Lv.50.
Keep Tiger Lily for the sixth beam; restart runs where Pomegranate misses her 다발 3.
Milk, Chardonnay, Brightseeker, Skating Queen, Tea Knight, Cheesecake at max level; Scorpion 7th in ATK.
Brightseeker to 10★ and her in-battle haste in the 40–50 band.
Once carries hold about 9M+ HP, level fillers under the 6th recipient's ATK so they outlive the 17 s wipe.
